claims.statement: Management targets 15-20% year-on-year volume growth for the next three years and aims to become a billion-dollar company in 3-4 years.
The 15-20% growth guidance includes all existing businesses but excludes revenue from the new defense plant.
A new hydraulic tube plant is under erection with Rs.141 crore capex, expected commissioning by July 2024.
Goodluck Defense and Aerospace plant progress is ahead of schedule; commissioning now expected by March-April 2025 vs original Q4 2026 plan.
Current capacity is 412,000 tons; will increase to 480,000 tons after new plant commissioning by March 2025.
Current capacity utilization is 87%; management aims to achieve 105% utilization from existing plants.
Infrastructure order book visibility is 9-10 months; forging order book is 3-4 months; auto tubes have weekly scheduling visibility.
New hydraulic tube plant has advance bookings before commissioning; revenue potential at peak is Rs.500-600 crore.
Defense and aerospace plant at full capacity expected to generate Rs.300-350 crore revenue.
Value-added products defined as those offering 10%+ EBITDA; new CDW tube project expected to yield 12-13% EBITDA.
EBITDA per ton improved from Rs.5,800 three years ago to ~Rs.8,400 currently; management aims for Rs.10,000 per ton but gives no fixed timeline.
Management expects overall margins to improve in current year due to rising steel supply, lower international prices, and proprietary value-added products.
